author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 


The proposal has been made to obsolete:
- **GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion**, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32674
- **GO:0072656 maintenance of protein location in mitochondrion**, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32673

The reason for obsoletion is:
- GO:0070585: it is an unnecessary grouping term. Protein import into mitochondria is now covered by **GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway** and its children. Protein *processing* is covered by **GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing**.
- GO:0072656: it does not describe a biological process.

Both are part of the removal of non-transport protein localization terms. Many current annotations describe a cytosolic protein being recruited to the mitochondrial surface as part of another process, such as mitophagy, mitochondrial fission, inflammasome assembly or apoptosis. Those should be annotated to that process instead. The proposed obsolete terms have:
- **no replaced_by**
- consider: GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway, GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing, GO:0061734 type 2 mitophagy, GO:0000266 mitochondrial fission

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PwxtW_R-zcfIzDA4n04jWeMXQm0V0hSI5ZIG3SGGiW4/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups:

| Group | GO:0070585 | GO:0072656 | - |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | 
| UniProt | 22 | – | 
| SGD | 16 | – |  
| ParkinsonsUK-UCL | 8 | 5 |  both done | 
| MGI | 10 | – |
| GeneDB | 9 | – | 
| TAIR | 8 | – |  
| RGD | 5 | – | 
| ComplexPortal | 3 | – | @sandraorchard 
| CGD | 3 | – | 
| DisProt | 2 | – |
| HGNC-UCL | 1 | – | done | 
| dictyBase | 1 | – | 

Non-experimental annotations:
- **GO:0070585, PAINT:** there are 638 IBA annotations from 12 PTN nodes in 11 PANTHER families. They are tracked separately in #6636 .
- **GO:0070585, other:** 69 ISO, 48 ISS, 9 TAS, 3 NAS, 3 IC and 1 ISA. The ISS/TAS/NAS/IC/ISA annotations belong to the curating groups above; ISO and Ensembl-projected IEA follow their source annotations.
- **GO:0072656:** 9 ISO and 38 Ensembl-projected IEA, which follow the ParkinsonsUK-UCL IMPs.

Production GO-CAMs using GO:0070585 (the barista search may also include descendants):
- 19 models generated from standard SGD and MGI annotations; these follow the annotations above
- 4 curated models that need manual edits:
  - gomodel:6606056e00001890: Activation of mitophagy in response to mitochondrial damage via activation of EIF2AK1/HRI by DELE1 (Human)
  - gomodel:60d5209a00001080: enabled by EMA19 Scer
  - gomodel:5e72450500002246: DJP1 and the ER-SURF pathway, ER to mitochondria
  - gomodel:5df932e000001410: Ap3b1 PMID:11058094

No GO-CAMs use GO:0072656.
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
- **InterPro2GO IPR037730** (Mitochondrial inner membrane protease subunit 2 family) → GO:0070585, 118 IEA. Suggest remapping to GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing. @sarach06 @tony787 @blazaropinto
- **ARBA00028355** → GO:0070585, 181 IEA. Please remove or remap the rule. @PedroRaposo

Thanks.
